questions.question: Nigeria makes use of which of the following voting systems?
Which of the following bodies conducts federal and state elections in Nigeria?
First-past-the-post is also known as the ________.
A free and fair election is best described as a ________ election.
Proportional representation is mostly associated with ________.
An electoral constituency is also known as an electoral ________.
Nigeria mainly uses which type of constituency for legislative elections?
The following are causes of electoral malpractice in Nigeria EXCEPT ________.
Free and fair elections are encouraged by all the following EXCEPT ________.
options: C. High level of political awareness

questions.question: Which electoral body conducted elections during Nigeria's Second Republic?
Nigeria's First Republic lasted from ________.
The division of a country into electoral constituencies is known as ________.
An economic system in which the state controls the means of production, distribution and exchange is called ________.
Individual ownership and control of the means of production, distribution and exchange is associated with ________.
The following are possible disadvantages of privatization EXCEPT ________.
The major objective of commercialization is to ensure ________.
options: D. Increased revenue generation and efficiency

questions.question: A socialist state can introduce capitalist principles through ________.
Public corporations are usually managed by a ________.
options: C. Group of junior civil servants

questions.question: A public corporation is normally established through ________.
The institution established to investigate complaints against maladministration is called the ________.
The following are methods of election EXCEPT ________.
The deprivation of a person's right to vote is known as ________.
The body of permanent officials that helps to formulate and implement government policies is the ________.
The highest general class in the traditional civil service structure is the ________.
All the following elections are conducted by INEC EXCEPT ________.
options: D. State House of Assembly election

questions.question: One major feature of public corporations weakened by privatization is ________.
In Nigeria, voting rights are granted to ________.
options: C. Adult Nigerian citizens aged 18 years and above

questions.question: In Nigeria, a presidential candidate must satisfy constitutional electoral requirements including ________.
options: B. Majority of valid votes with the required geographical spread

questions.question: An election conducted to fill a vacant legislative seat is called a ________.
When voters choose representatives who subsequently make decisions on their behalf, the system is described as ________.
Which body registers political parties and supervises elections in Nigeria?
A person who has the legal right to vote is known as an ________.
The permanent and politically neutral nature of the civil service is known as ________.
Civil servants are expected to serve successive governments without openly supporting a political party. This is known as ________.
The sale of government-owned enterprises to private individuals is known as ________.
Commercialization requires a public enterprise to operate more like a ________.
A major reason for establishing public corporations is to provide ________.
Which of the following is a characteristic of the civil service?
The official responsible for declaring the result of an election is commonly called the ________.
Secret voting is important mainly because it protects the voter's ________.
